body:
Done. Merged to develop as 5f70d3f01e8449f77908db6ed9673c72855dca9a.

Implemented views/filters/sorting on top of the data layer: views table + view_items (curated membership with position ordering), the filter tree (14 conditions + 3 connectives) compiled to pushed-down SQL, sort/groupBy/propertyOrder/visibility/widths in viewConfig, the ViewTypeRegistry extension point (registration only, no concrete view types), createInlineDatabase, and created_by ownership enforcement (agent can't set is_default or write another actor's view).

Notes for dependent issues:
- queryView() in views/viewQuery.ts is the entry point for both filtered (database-backed) and curated (cross-database) views.
- Curated-view cursor is a numeric position (not an item id) — validated, throws ValidationError on a non-numeric cursor.
- addViewItem takes a `SELECT ... FROM views WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE` lock first to serialize concurrent membership writes on the same view.

Second production run of the pipeline: the agent again finished the implementation, opened the PR, and got stuck the same way as issue #21 (believing it would be "notified" when a background check resolved, in headless mode there's no such notification) — but this time the run-agent.sh safety net worked as intended and pushed the unfinished state to a recovery branch instead of losing it (`wip/issue-22-20260828-020719`, safe to delete, not needed once merged). PR #62 was otherwise clean: 4/4 acceptance criteria, checks green. I fixed 2 medium findings (cursor NaN silently returning empty results, an unlocked position race in addViewItem) before merging.

This "finishes the implementation but doesn't complete the mechanical wrap-up" failure mode has now happened twice despite the work-issue skill fix after issue #21. Worth another look at the skill/harness before relying on this being fully unattended.
